purpose: Test target-time alignment of positive training emphasis with causal sensor-tail pulse onsets, not a new negative weighting, model family, feature or inference policy.
single_change: Replace label-onset positive mass0.25 by sensor-tail-pulse-aligned mass0.25; all other V12 statistical components unchanged.

q95.population: ALL original training rows with label exactly0 and finite original float64 frozen IF raw anomaly score, including HGB-ineligible rows

pulses.axis: Full original raw training axis before label/eligibility filtering
pulses.tail: finite raw IF >= fixed training-normal q95
pulses.episode: Maximal contiguous True run of tail
pulses.confirmed_start: start>0 and immediately previous raw IF finite and belowq95
pulses.censored: series-start and starts after unavailable/nonfiniteIF are not confirmed and receive no pulse bonus
pulses.window: Original offsets0,1,2 from each confirmed start, truncated at actual tail episode end; rows must remain in that same tail episode

weights.positive_event_definition: original contiguous label1 segment; unknown/normal end segment
weights.pulse_distribution: Uniform over positive segments with at least one nonempty confirmed-pulse-window intersection with HGB-eligible label1 rows, then uniformly over those eligible pulses within that segment, then uniformly over its eligible intersecting rows
weights.global_no_eligible_bonus_fallback: Move0.25 into event-uniformmass, making0.375; never substitute another window or shift to later eligible rows

fixed: V12 features/reference statistics/IF estimator/HGBparams/availability/scoring plus V10 selection/certification/pending/rescue unchanged. No new model family/threshold grid/fit on calibration/test.
limitations: IF training representation remains in-sample, not cross-fitted or prequential.
Every source/period is previously disclosed development data.
V6 past fallback is conditional reference and does not guarantee V8 retention. V8 retained as separately fixed evaluation gate, not selectioninput.
A three-sample training emphasis is not an inference latency guarantee.
No live streaming parity or RaspberryPi latency qualification, no3D/valve integration.
